details.title: Subcontractor Services Agreement

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. ... Subject to Section 12.2, the courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

details.parties_quote: This Subcontractor Services Agreement (together with the Engagement Schedule and any amendments hereto, this "Agreement") is entered into as of the date of the last signature below (the "Effective Date") by and between AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a private limited company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("AtliQ"), and Kriti Data Labs LLP, a limited liability partnership registered under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, having its office at Office No. 7, 2nd Floor, Shreeji Heights, Kothrud, Pune 411038, Maharashtra, India ("Vendor"). AtliQ and Vendor are each a "Party" and collectively the "Parties."

payment_source.quote: AtliQ's obligation to pay any invoice is conditional upon AtliQ's receipt of payment from the End Client for the corresponding services. AtliQ shall pay each properly submitted, undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days after AtliQ receives the corresponding payment from the End Client, and in any event not later than one hundred and twenty (120) days after AtliQ's receipt of the invoice.

details.services_summary: Cleansing, labelling and annotation of machine-sensor time-series data and maintenance records for a data pipeline modernisation project.

liability_cap.basis: FEES ACTUALLY PAID BY ATLIQ TO VENDOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT
liability_cap.quote: ATLIQ'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES ACTUALLY PAID BY ATLIQ TO VENDOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.

delay_penalty.quote: If Vendor fails to achieve any Delivery Date, Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.

details.one_sided_note: Confidentiality obligations in Article 6 bind Vendor only.

findings.title: Unfair to the other side: payment in 120 days
findings.why: AtliQ's own paper puts this on the other party. AtliQ rejects it as a supplier, and its stated preference is for balanced terms.
findings.quote: AtliQ's obligation to pay any invoice is conditional upon AtliQ's receipt of payment from the End Client for the corresponding services. AtliQ shall pay each properly submitted, undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days after AtliQ receives the corresponding payment from the End Client, and in any event not later than one hundred and twenty (120) days after AtliQ's receipt of the invoice.

findings.title: Unpaid work in progress on termination for convenience
findings.why: Denies payment for partial work done if AtliQ terminates for convenience.
findings.comparison: Principle requires AtliQ to be paid for work done upon termination.
findings.quote: AtliQ's sole obligation shall be to pay Fees for Deliverables accepted... AtliQ shall have no obligation to pay for work in progress

findings.title: Vendor retains annotation outputs
findings.why: Vendor keeps annotation outputs, which prevents AtliQ or the end client from owning the final delivered work.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles state the client owns what is built; past contracts pass deliverables upon payment.
findings.quote: Vendor shall retain all right, title and interest in and to its tools, labelling platform, scripts, ontologies, annotation guidelines developed by Vendor, and annotation outputs, including all intellectual property rights therein (collectively, "Vendor IP").

findings.title: One-sided indemnity covers AtliQ's negligence
findings.why: AtliQ covers the other side's own negligence and the indemnity is not mutual in this clause.
findings.comparison: AtliQ's principles require mutual indemnity and state AtliQ does not cover the other side's negligence.
findings.quote: regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee.

findings.title: Uncapped vendor liability
findings.why: Vendor liability is completely uncapped while AtliQ's liability is capped at fees paid, creating an imbalance.
findings.comparison: AtliQ prefers liability to be about 1x the fees for both sides.
findings.quote: NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT OR EXCLUDE VENDOR'S LIABILITY FOR ANY LOSSES, WHETHER DIRECT OR INDIRECT, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT

findings.title: Excessive uncapped delay penalties
findings.why: Penalty of 2 percent per day with no cap and no exclusion for client-caused delays harms the vendor.
findings.comparison: Past contracts cap delay penalties at 5% to 10% total and exclude client delays.
findings.quote: an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.

findings.title: No data processing agreement on record for this party in the tracker
findings.why: Personal data needs a signed data processing agreement before it is shared.
findings.comparison: Healthcare deals need an NDA, a BAA and the services contract; European work with personal data needs a DPA.

findings.title: Unilateral updates to standards
findings.why: Unilateral updates can impose new obligations without agreement on cost or feasibility.
findings.comparison: AtliQ prefers changes to be handled via mutual change orders.
findings.quote: in accordance with the highest standards of the industry, and in compliance with AtliQ's annotation guidelines and quality requirements made available to Vendor, as updated from time to time.

findings.title: Unlimited acceptance cycles and full refunds
findings.why: Exposes the supplier to endless rework and complete forfeiture of fees upon rejection.
findings.comparison: AtliQ usually restricts rejection and refund rights to defined cure periods.
findings.quote: AtliQ may repeat the acceptance process until the Deliverable conforms, or may, at its option, reject the Deliverable and receive a refund of all Fees paid in respect thereof.

findings.title: Unilateral and rigid acceptance criteria
findings.why: Denies acceptance through normal operational milestones, locking payments indefinitely.
findings.comparison: Standard contracts allow deemed acceptance after a specified passage of time.
findings.quote: Acceptance shall not be deemed to occur by use, by delivery to the End Client, by payment, or by the passage of time.

findings.title: One-sided confidentiality protection
findings.why: Protects only AtliQ's information and leaves Vendor's disclosures unmasked.
findings.comparison: Principle requires confidentiality to be mutual.
findings.quote: "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by or on behalf of AtliQ or the End Client

findings.title: Cumulative delay penalties and actual damages
findings.why: Allows stacking of liquidated damages with actual damages, increasing exposure.
findings.comparison: AtliQ prefers balanced and capped remedies.
findings.quote: Liquidated damages under this Article are in addition to and not in lieu of AtliQ's right to recover its actual damages

findings.title: Removal of vendor personnel at sole discretion
findings.why: Forces removal of staff without cause, potentially disrupting delivery timelines.
findings.comparison: AtliQ's own paper typically requires reasonable cause for personnel removal.
findings.quote: AtliQ may, in its sole discretion, request removal of any Vendor Personnel, and Vendor shall promptly replace such individual at no additional cost to AtliQ.
